name: policy-compiler
description: Compile a written policy into grounded deontic norms (O/P/F with bearer, action, conditions, cross-references), surfacing conflicts, undetermined rules, and unplaceable spans, and running test cases. Stops at a validated draft; activation is reserved. Delegates lowering to the loomground deontic/norm planes when present, degrading to advisory when absent. Output matches the compliance-fleet grounding seam.
